
### traceroute  {.smaller}


* ICMP Time Exceeded messages come from router
* $\rightarrow$ tells you which routers are involved 
<hr class="vspace" />
* <code>traceroute</code> command: deliberately packets with low TTL/hop limit
* print out what time exceeded messages we get back
* typically sent with TTL/hop limit = 255 so it doesn't get lost 

   * (‘backwards’ path might be longer than forwards one)

### traceroute sent 


![](/routing-intro/traceroute-v4-send){fig-alt="Wireshark screenshot showing series of UDP packets from 128.143.71.27 to 193.0.11.51, most of which are colored red to indicate an error was detected later. A column shows the TTLs of the UDP packets as 1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3, etc."}


### traceroute received 


![](/routing-intro/traceroute-v4-recv){fig-alt="Wireshark screenshot showing ICMP time-to-live exceeded messages sent from various routers to 128.143.71.27. A TTL column shows two numbers for each message, the first is high giving the TTL for the ICMP message itself. The second is 1 or 2, showing the TTL of the original UDP message contained in the ICMP message."}


### aside: multiple paths 


* only showing <i>forward</i> path 

   * routing in reverse direction is often different

* sometimes multiple forward paths 

   * way we've shown routing table so far does not allow this
